Rape of a young child
Sentencing guideline
Effective from 03 March 2026
Rape of a young child
Sentencing guideline
Page 2 of 13
Applicability

1. This guideline applies to all offenders who are sentenced on or after 03 March 2026, and who
have been convicted of one of the following offences:
• an offence under section 18 of the Sexual Offences (Scotland) Act 2009 (rape of a
young child)1
• the common law offence of rape where the victim is a young child (a child under the age
of 13).

1 Section 18 defines a young child as a child ‘who has not attained the age of 13 years’ .
Rape of a young child
Sentencing guideline
Page 3 of 13
How to use this guideline

2. This guideline should be read alongside the Council’s guidelines ‘Principles and purposes of
sentencing’ and ‘The sentencing process’. It should also be read along with any other
guidelines which apply to the case, or to the offender. Details of guidelines in force can be
found on the Council's website.
